business_insights.stockout_prevalence: 13.68% of observation days experience stockout risk where demand exceeds on-hand stock.
business_insights.overstock_prevalence: 41.97% of records exhibit excess inventory exceeding 3x daily demand.
business_insights.promotion_impact: Promotions increase average daily demand from 95.0 to 123.3 units (an uplift of 29.7%).
business_insights.policy_recommendation: Products classified as High Volatility (e.g. fashion/seasonal clothing) require dynamic safety stock buffers, whereas Stable Demand products (groceries) can operate with fixed periodic review replenishment cycles.
